pitfalls.text: H3 ships in two routes, always both: free weights (video_acme_h3_*) and paid nodes (api_acme_h3_*). Never claim only the paid path exists.
Both routes' templates share display titles. Disambiguate by internal name.
Free i2v is also first-last-frame: last_frame on AcmeH3ImageToVideo is optional and unwired on purpose.
There is no free video_acme_h3_flf2v file. That name is paid-only.
The partner registry carries no H3 entry, only the older Halo proxy.
The alias 'halo' is the older family, never H3. But "Halo 03" does mean H3.
The paid node's enums are not the model's limits. A request outside the presets means offer the free route, not declare it impossible.
Generation time scales with pixel count faster than linearly.
Recommend the int8 base model and the low-precision text encoder.
Generate at the native canvas and upscale later.
Needs a recent server. Six templates: three local, three paid.
A successful local run is proof the free route works.
